title: triticum vulgare var. atratum
intro: Triticum vulgare var. atratum, commonly known as black rye, is a type of rye plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of black rye include its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and infections. The bioactive constituents of black rye include phenolic compounds, such as ferulic acid and scopoletin, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
